paite: Nou siampute aw, hiai za un, nou Israel inkote aw, ngaikhia un, kumpipa inkote aw, bildoh un, na tung ua vaihawmna hong tung ding ahi; Mizpah a thang leh Tabor tung a lenthang na hi khinta uhi.
heading: Hosia Thuhilhna
english: “Listen to this, you priests! Listen, house of Israel, and give ear, house of the king! For the judgment is against you; for you have been a snare at Mizpah, and a net spread on Tabor.

paite: Mithahna lam ah thukpi in akihelta ua; himahleh amaute tengteng thuhilhpa ka hi.
english: The rebels are deep in slaughter; but I discipline all of them.

paite: Ephraim ka thei a, Israel ka lak ah sel in a-om kei; Ephraim aw, tu in, kizuak in na omta a, Israel abuahta hi.
english: I know Ephraim, and Israel is not hidden from me; for now, Ephraim, you have played the prostitute. Israel is defiled.

paite: Athilbawlte un a Pathian kiang lam angasak kei ding hi; asung uah kizuakna kha a-om a, TOUPA athei kei uhi.
heading: Hosia In Milim Biakna Adem
english: Their deeds won’t allow them to turn to their God; for the spirit of prostitution is within them, and they don’t know Yahweh.

paite: Israel kisaktheihna in amai ah atheihpih a; huaiziak in athulimlouhna uah Israel leh Ephraim akisuipuk ding ua, Judah leng amaute toh apukkhawm ding hi.
english: The pride of Israel testifies to his face. Therefore Israel and Ephraim will stumble in their iniquity. Judah also will stumble with them.

paite: TOUPA zong ding in abawnghonte uh leh abelamhonte uh toh akuan ding ua; himahleh amah amu kei ding uh; amau a kipan in akihemkheta hi.
english: They will go with their flocks and with their herds to seek Yahweh; but they won’t find him. He has withdrawn himself from them.

paite: TOUPA tung ah lepchiahtak in agamta ua; ta lamdangte anei ua; tu in aloute uh toh kha thak in amau anegai ding hi.
english: They are unfaithful to Yahweh; for they have borne illegitimate children. Now the new moon will devour them with their fields.

paite: Gibeah ah na pengkul binei uh mut unla, Ramah ah pengkul; Beth-aven ah ngaihtak in kikou un; aw Benjamin, ka hon zui uhi.
heading: Judah Leh Israel Kidouna
english: “Blow the cornet in Gibeah, and the trumpet in Ramah! Sound a battle cry at Beth Aven, behind you, Benjamin!

paite: Salhna ni in Ephraim asegawp ding a; ahong om ngeingei ding Israel namte lak ah ka theisakta hi.
english: Ephraim will become a desolation in the day of rebuke. Among the tribes of Israel, I have made known that which will surely be.

paite: Judah heutute zaw gamgi chiamtehna lamangte bang ahi uh; tui bang in atung uah ka hehna ka sungbo ding hi.
english: The princes of Judah are like those who remove a landmark. I will pour out my wrath on them like water.

paite: Epraim nuaisiah in a-om, vaihawmna ah delhkhum in a-om, thupiak zui a om alungkim ziak in.
english: Ephraim is oppressed, he is crushed in judgment; Because he is intent in his pursuit of idols.

paite: Huaiziak in Ephraim a ding in puannget leh Judah inkote a ding in siatna ka hi ding hi.
english: Therefore I am to Ephraim like a moth, and to the house of Judah like rottenness.

paite: Ephraim in achinatna amuh a, Judah in aliamna amuh chiang in, huchi in Assuria kiang ah Ephraim ahoh a, kumpipa Jareb kiang ah asawl a; himahleh nang ahon hihdam thei kei a, na liamna leng ahihdam thei sam kei hi.
english: “When Ephraim saw his sickness, and Judah his wound, Then Ephraim went to Assyria, and sent to king Jareb: but he is not able to heal you, neither will he cure you of your wound.

paite: Ephraim a ding a humpinelkai bang leh Judah inkote a ding a humpinelkai lun lai bang ka hih ziak in; kei, kei mahmah in, ka botnen ding a ka paimang ding; ka pomang ding a; honkhe ding kuamah a-om kei ding hi.
english: For I will be to Ephraim like a lion, and like a young lion to the house of Judah. I myself will tear in pieces and go away. I will carry off, and there will be no one to deliver.

paite: Atatkhelhna uh thupha atawi ua, ka mel azon masiah uh, ka pai dia ka mun ah ka kik nawn ding; agimthuakna uah chihtaktak in kei ahon zong ding uhi.
heading: Israel Thuphatawina
english: I will go and return to my place, until they acknowledge their offense, and seek my face. In their affliction they will seek me earnestly.”
